title: Hardship and Protective Holds — Recertification Allowance by Age of the Latest Certificate
content:
When an updated physician's medical or disability certification is asked for on a running Long-Term Hardship Hold under Hardship and Protective Holds, a certification age allowance is added once to the days allowed for the recertification. It depends on the calendar days since the latest physician's certification on the hold arrived:

| Calendar days since the latest certification on the hold arrived | Certification age allowance |
|---|---|
| At least the stale-certification days, 45 | 5 calendar days (stale-certification allowance) |
| At least the aging-certification days, 21, but fewer than 45 | 2 calendar days (aging-certification allowance) |
| Fewer than 21 | None |

## Boundary rows

| Days since arrival | Allowance |
|---|---|
| 20 | None |
| 21 | 2 days |
| 44 | 2 days |
| 45 | 5 days |

**Example (hypothetical).** The latest certification on the hold arrived on 1 May and the recertification is requested on 20 June, 50 calendar days later: at least 45, so 5 calendar days are added.
